subject: Lighthouse Analytics trial sprint — lighthouse plan & gates
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@lighthouseanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Lighthouse discovery — proposed trial sprint and success gates

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate the transparency on Lighthouse's ingestion cadence and what success looks like for you (realtime freshness + <1s query P50 for top-50 queries). Per our notes, I wanted to put a concise plan on your radar so we can lock dates and owners: 

Summary of proposed trial sprint (compact):
- Scope: 14-day trial focused on query latency and embedding-powered rerank for top-50 queries.
- Success criteria (pass/fail):
  - P50 query latency < 1s at production-like payloads
  - End-to-end accuracy: same-or-better rerank quality compared to current baseline (A/B on top-50 queries)
  - No sensitive data persisted in hosted logs; retention policy 7 days for debug tokens
- Timeline (draft):
  - Kickoff / environment provisioning: target week of Jul 9 (one-week provisioning window)
  - Week 1: integration + smoke load tests
  - Week 2: full-run, A/B readout and final metrics capture
  - Final readout: Aug 2 (30 days after kickoff to allow thorough analysis)
- Owners:
  - Redwood technical lead: Rishi Malhotra
  - Customer success / trial ops: Monica Patel
  - Commercial: me (Kimberly)

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm kickoff week (Jul 9 or earlier if you can provision infra on your side)
2) Security questionnaire + evidence exchange — see attached MOP and MAP (stubs attached: lighthouse-mop-v1.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx)
3) I’ll schedule recurring 30-min check-ins (weekly) and a final readout slot; let me know any calendar constraints.

Attachments: lighthouse-mop-v1.xlsx (POC runbook), mutual-action-plan.docx (mutual action plan stub)

If Jul 9 works, I’ll send the calendar invite and pass owners the prep checklist.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@lighthouseanalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Liao <tim.liao@lighthouseanalytics.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Lighthouse discovery — proposed trial sprint and success gates

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap. Jul 9 is workable on our side, but two quick items before we lock: 

1) Security/compliance: our security team will need a short SOC2 summary and a network diagram for any hosted-run trials. Can you share a one-pager and any redaction guarantees for logs?
2) Data posture: we'll be sending PII-adjacent product queries. Please confirm retention and encryption-at-rest details.

Assuming those are OK, we’re aligned to kickoff Jul 9. Also — can we make the weekly stand Tuesdays at 10am PT? Tim (cc’d) will lead from our engineering side.

Avery Collins
Head of Product | Lighthouse Analytics
avery.collins@lighthouseanalytics.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@lighthouseanalytics.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Lighthouse discovery — proposed trial sprint and success gates

Appreciate the clarity, Avery — quick answers: 

- SOC2 summary: attaching a short stub (SOC2-summary.pdf) that outlines scope and our audit cadence.
- Network diagram: attached (network-architecture.png) that highlights VPC peering options and private endpoint configuration for Private deployment. If you prefer hosted, we redact payloads and truncate debug logs after 7 days.
- Encryption: all persisted data in our hosted platform is AES-256 at rest; TLS1.3 in transit.

We can commit to Jul 9 kickoff and weekly Tuesdays 10am PT. Owners confirmed:
- Redwood technical lead for POC workstreams: me (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com)
- Customer success and trial ops: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.com)

I’ll prepare an integration checklist (data sample sizing, API keys, test queries) and share before the kickoff.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, network-architecture.png

Cheers,
Rishi
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

I’ve locked the kickoff for Jul 9 at 10:00am PT and sent a calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdef1234567890. Recurring weekly check-ins Tuesdays 10am PT (30m) are on the invite.
